data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 asserts the large service necessarily has a shared administrative layer, but 'strictly more total internal redundancy' can include organizational redundancy: independent teams, staggered release schedules, isolated deployment pipelines, and siloed security policies. Its own countercondition concedes the mechanism fails if the large service maintains strictly siloed administrative teams with zero shared dependencies. Since the problem statement supplies no premise that the large service must have one HR/security/deployment backbone, the core mechanism is only conditionally valid, not an argument for the general claim.
